reviews.originalText:
Exceptional Experience from Start to Finish**

After extensive research, I chose this clinic for my rhinoplasty in Turkey, and it was one of the best decisions I have ever made.

The package included hotel accommodation with breakfast, all transportation between the hotel and the clinic, and one night in the hospital, which made the entire experience completely stress-free. Everything was perfectly organized from the moment I arrived.

I traveled with my partner, and I was pleasantly surprised by how well he was treated throughout the process. He did not have to pay anything extra, and while I was in the hospital, he was also provided with three meals a day. The staff made sure both of us felt comfortable and well taken care of at all times.

I would especially like to thank the doctor for his professionalism, attention to detail, and genuine care. He listened carefully to everything I wanted, answered all my questions, and made me feel confident and reassured throughout the entire journey.

The medical team, coordinators, nurses, and hotel staff were all incredibly kind, professional, and supportive. The clinic was modern, clean, and operated to a very high standard.

Most importantly, I am absolutely in love with my results. My new nose is exactly what I asked for—natural, balanced, and perfectly suited to my face. The doctor truly understood my vision and exceeded my expectations.

I highly recommend this clinic to anyone considering rhinoplasty in Turkey. The quality of care, outstanding service, and amazing results make it a 10/10 experience.

Thank you to the entire team for making this journey such a positive and unforgettable one. I couldn't be happier with my results!
reviews.ownerReply: Dear Danna, what a joy to read this! We are thrilled that your rhinoplasty journey in Istanbul felt stress-free from arrival to results, and that your partner felt just as welcome and cared for as you did. Hearing that your new nose is exactly what you envisioned is the greatest reward for our whole team. Thank you for trusting us after all your research — enjoy your beautiful results! — Vivid Clinic Team

reviews.originalText:
It’s been over three months since I have had my procedures. I wanted to wait and do the review after I felt recovered. I went all out and had 360 liposuction, breast augmentation and a fat graft to do a bbl. The recovery is brutal and you will need some help if you choose to do it all together….but I’m glad I did. One and done. I’ve never felt better in my body. I was a bit scared when I woke up and had a literally huge behind but as they said I didn’t retain all of the fat…thank goodness and now I have a nice normal behind where there was once a pancake. I chose to keep relatively small breasts, I’ve always worn a padded bra but not anymore, I now where pretty ones with some support. I must admit I’m still waiting for the full drop and fluff to happen…. They aren’t hard as rocks anymore but still not fluffy and a bit sensitive still. The most difficult procedure was the liposuction….phew. After 3 months though I’m starting to feel almost normal on the outside you can’t see anything but a few little scars which I am treating but the inside is still tender…..but boy do I look great!

Kadir and his team are awesome, kind, funny and extremely helpful. During the experience I felt very well cared for. Thank you.

Dr. Erkan works magic. When I first met him he was a bit quiet and reserved and I wasn’t 100% comfortable. You don’t meet your Dr. until shortly before the procedure takes place which is not what I’m used to and you don’t have contact with him after you go home but I guess that’s how it’s done there and it keeps the prices down I suppose. After my procedure was done his after care at the hospital was outstanding he was gentle, kind with a perfect bedside manner…he’s even got a good sense of humor.

The hotel was in a great location that’s for sure. Lots of sightseeing to do which I did of course before the procedures. The rooftop restaurant offers great views and delicious food…..I like a softer and bigger bed…my only complaint.

If you decide to take this journey in life I highly recommend you use Dr. Erkan and Kadir and team. You may be in pain for a while but you will not have any regrets. This review is true and honest.
reviews.ownerReply: What an honest and generous review — thank you for waiting three months to share how your recovery has really felt. We know combining several procedures makes for a demanding healing journey, so it means everything to hear you have never felt better in your body. Dr. Erkan and Kadir's team will be so pleased to read your words, sense-of-humour compliment included, and we will pass your note about the hotel beds along as well. Wishing you continued smooth healing! — Vivid Clinic Team

reviews.originalText:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Experiencia muy buena y acompañamiento constante
Mi experiencia con Vivid Clinic ha sido muy positiva y quiero compartirla para ayudar a otras personas que estén valorando operarse fuera de su país.
Desde el primer contacto, la coordinación fue clara y constante. Antes del viaje me explicaron todo el proceso, resolvieron mis dudas y estuvieron disponibles por WhatsApp en todo momento, lo cual da mucha tranquilidad cuando se trata de una cirugía importante.
Al llegar a Estambul, el traslado aeropuerto–hotel fue puntual y cómodo. El hotel La Quinta cumplió perfectamente: limpio, tranquilo y con restaurante, algo fundamental durante el postoperatorio, ya que los primeros días no es recomendable salir.
El día de las pruebas y la cirugía todo estuvo muy bien organizado. El Prof. Dr. Özgür demostró ser un gran profesional: cercano, claro en sus explicaciones y muy cuidadoso, transmitiendo confianza desde el primer momento. La cirugía se realizó según lo previsto y el seguimiento posterior fue constante.
Quiero destacar especialmente el trabajo del coordinador del procedimiento, Kadir, que estuvo pendiente de mí en todo momento, resolviendo dudas, organizando traslados, revisiones y masajes, y ayudando incluso con detalles del viaje de regreso. En un postoperatorio tan exigente, ese apoyo marca una gran diferencia.
También agradecer a la enfermera Tuğba, por su trato cercano, su paciencia y su atención durante el postoperatorio, haciendo que todo fuera más llevadero en los momentos más delicados.
El postoperatorio no es fácil (hay que ser realista), pero me sentí cuidada, escuchada y acompañada, tanto en el hospital como en el hotel. La comunicación ha sido fluida incluso después de la cirugía.
En resumen, recomiendo Vivid Clinic por su organización, profesionalidad, trato humano y seguimiento continuo. Si estás pensando en operarte, mi consejo es informarte bien, preguntar todo lo que necesites y saber que con un equipo así no estás sola en ningún momento.
Gracias a todo el equipo por el trato y el apoyo durante todo el proceso
reviews.translatedText:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Excellent experience and constant support
My experience with Vivid Clinic has been very positive, and I want to share it to help others considering surgery abroad.

From the first contact, the coordination was clear and consistent. Before my trip, they explained the entire process, answered all my questions, and were available via WhatsApp at all times, which is very reassuring when it comes to a major surgery.
Upon arrival in Istanbul, the airport-hotel transfer was punctual and comfortable. The La Quinta Hotel was perfect: clean, quiet, and with a restaurant, which is essential during the postoperative period, as going out is not recommended for the first few days.
On the day of the tests and surgery, everything was very well organized. Professor Dr. Özgür proved to be a true professional: approachable, clear in his explanations, and very careful, instilling confidence from the very beginning. The surgery was performed as planned, and the follow-up care was consistent.

I want to especially highlight the work of the procedure coordinator, Kadir, who was attentive to me at all times, answering my questions, organizing transfers, check-ups, and massages, and even helping with details of my return trip. In such a demanding post-operative period, that support makes a huge difference.

I also want to thank nurse Tuğba for her kindness, patience, and attention during the post-operative period, making everything more bearable during the most delicate moments. Post-operative recovery isn't easy (we have to be realistic), but I felt cared for, listened to, and supported, both in the hospital and at the hotel. Communication has been smooth even after the surgery.
In short, I recommend Vivid Clinic for its organization, professionalism, compassionate care, and continuous follow-up. If you are considering surgery, my advice is to do your research, ask all the questions you need, and know that with a team like this, you are never alone. Thank you to the entire team for their care and support throughout the entire process.
reviews.ownerReply: Querida Kenly, mil gracias por compartir tu experiencia con tanto detalle: sin duda ayudará a muchas personas que están valorando operarse fuera de su país.
